brief: White silhouettes like historical originals, no blue square or disc. On card left, point/tip/head upper-left and grip lower-right. Non-directional categories naturally centered. Index 11 is generic guitar, never Momo flute. Preserve all 20 category indexes and mechanics.

method.reason: Explicit permission to extract known assets through the native workflow. V2/scripts/prepare_assets.cjs already isolates white glyphs with sharp/min-RGB alpha and renders native SVG glyphs. Historical weapon geometry is recovered from actual workbook JPEGs, not from colored paintings.
method.historical_geometry: 19 icons preserve the complete 46x46 source coordinate system without mirroring, rotation or cropping; index 11 is the explicitly requested native vector guitar.
method.source_limitations: All 20 historical weapon JPEGs are 46x46. The V2/V3 armes_transparentes SVG files embed those JPEGs with circular clips; they contain no editable weapon path geometry. No higher-resolution complete native weapon set was found in the inspected main workbooks or template assets. The extraction intentionally retains the original small-symbol character; it is not a claimed recovery of nonexistent high-resolution vector masters.
method.image_processing: Extract existing white glyphs only; remove edge-connected white frame and low-level JPEG speckles; cubic interpolation followed by alpha smoothstep; RGB fixed to white. No colored painting is processed, recolored or traced.

evidence.template_findings: Historical left weapon slot confirmed visually. Layer inventory contains raster long-sword/whip/bow layers and a staff smart object, not a complete vector set of 20.
evidence.source_visual_inspection: view_image: historical-20.png (all 20 originals at nearest-neighbor 184px) and Template_Kalistar_Card_PROPRE_preview.png; original axe JPEG and V2 PNG also viewed individually.

qa.visual_inspection_method: view_image on the complete final 20-icon contact sheets, both dark card-like circular slots and checkerboard, with each asset actually rendered at 90 x 90 px. Circle/checker are QA backgrounds only, not present in delivered PNGs.
qa.alpha_contract: All 20 are 512x512 RGBA PNG. Alpha min 0 / max 255; entire outer edge alpha 0; all visible RGB exactly (255,255,255). Transparent interior cutouts and antialiased edges, no blue support, baked checker, frame or medallion.
qa.mechanics_contract: Index 00..19 and category names are read directly from the unchanged V3/donnees/armes.json. No matrix, card data, renderer, UI or Photoshop changes.
qa.integration_approval: pending_parent; production QA is not user approval
